title: Read an office queue
caption: queues/page.tsx and queues/[queueId]/page.tsx. queues:read (owner, admin, agent). Monitored queues are set in the portal and polled every 15 min by the OTA worker.

steps.title: List
steps.body: See the newest reads grouped by office, queue and category.
steps.expect: Each row: last read time, reader ("Monitored" for the poller), PNR count.

steps.title: Open a queue
steps.body: **Open a queue**: number 0-99, category 0-254, office; press **Open queue**.
steps.expect: The last stored read with its PNRs; no Amadeus call; invalid values named at their fields.

steps.title: Read now
steps.expect: A fresh read (`?read=1`), one new `queue_snapshots` row with `fetched_by_staff_id` = you; **Next page** pages it without calling Amadeus.
